summary:
If analytics aren’t directly tied to business KPIs, you’re leaving strategic value on the table. Leaders must establish clear frameworks that translate technical insights into measurable business outcomes. By linking analytical findings to executive priorities, you’ll maximize ROI and empower decision makers with actionable intelligence. This alignment is the key to building a truly data-driven culture and making analytics investments count.

Come together with peers to discuss:

Bridging the gap between analytics and KPIs
Using AI to turn data into strategic insights
Aligning analytics with business goals to maximize ROI

Join these Peer Meetups, powered by Gartner CDAO Communities, for a networking session that allows you to connect and share with a small group of your peers facilitated by a CDAO Community Member. Please make every effort to attend as other attendees will be looking forward to meeting with you.
